0.99: Faithfulness-gate threshold (jlens/src/bin/spike.rs): the native candle forward reproduces the shipped fastembed embeddings at cosine > 0.99. A stated method/reproducibility constant, not an extracted result number.
0.05: Finite-difference epsilon for the delta-broadcast averaged Jacobian (jlens/src/lib.rs, layer_jacobian; PAPER.md 4.2). A method constant, not a result.
250: Leave-one-out identity-decode sample size n_align (jlens/src/bin/steer.rs:27 default), used by the reproducibility command; the per-layer identity accuracies are computed over these 250 evenly-spread non-mystery passages.
